newsitem.title: MEXICO: S&P rates Carso commercial paper MXA-1.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Carso commercial paper MXA-1.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had assigned a rating of MXA-1 to 1.3 billion pesos of commercial paper issued by Mexican industrial firm Grupo Carso SA.
Carso issued the paper last week, the rating agency said in a statement.
The agency said the rating reflects the company's mix of businesses and standing as market leaders in most of their industries. It also said it reflects the solidity of the company's balance sheet.
Carso, one of Mexico's biggest companies, has interests in copper cable, mining, cigarettes, retail and tires.
